Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: where Costing for Persons sits in Redwood; the Advanced Search and Effective As-of Date labels; the Actions and Edit menu labels; that a regular HCM (not a super-user) sees Our Workforce and this quick action.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

Once an assignment or element has costing, you change it with the Edit menu on Costing for Persons. There are four actions, and each one needs a specific search date. Picking the right action and date is the whole skill.

Always review the costing History first so you know which periods already have costing.

Use this whenCosting already exists and needs to start differently, be fixed, stop, or be removed.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Which action, which search date
ActionUse it toSearch on
UpdateStart a different costing as of a date. History is kept and a new record is added.First day of the pay period the new costing starts
CorrectRevise an existing costing for its entire date range.First day of the pay period it should have started
End DateStop costing as of a pay period end date.Last day of the last pay period it should apply
Delete RecordRemove a costing record completely.First day of the pay period of the record to remove

Watch-outs

  • Don't End Date a prior period if you want to keep costing records that come after that date. End Date ends everything from that date forward.
  • After End Date, use Create (not Update) to add costing again later.
  • Dates matter most. Check History before every change.
  • Vanderbilt's guide is dated 01/27/2022, before the Redwood screens. Confirm labels in a recorded demo.

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Costing Management

Change existing costing

Use when: Costing already exists and needs to start differently, be fixed, stop, or be removed. · System: Oracle HCM (Costing for Persons)

  1. Decide which action you need.
  2. Open Costing for Persons and search with the action's date.
    • Update, Correct, or Delete Record: the first day of the pay period the change applies to.
    • End Date: the last day of the pay period the costing should apply to.
  3. Select the Assignment (or Element) on the left.
  4. Click History and review every costing period.
  5. Click Edit and choose the action.
    • Update: enter the new costing lines. With no end date, it continues going forward.
    • Correct: enter the costing as it should have been for the whole selected period.
    • End Date: stops all costing from that date. An assignment returns to the work unit default; an element returns to the assignment's costing.
    • Delete Record: confirm the pop-up with OK. The previous record's end date extends to close the gap.
  6. Enter or adjust the lines so they total 100%, then click Submit.
  7. Prior periods: submit the Retro Costing Request Form (Salary).
  8. Click Done, then run the HCM Cost Allocation Verification Plan report.
Which action, which search date
ActionUse it toSearch on

CorrectRevise an existing costing for its entire date range.First day of the pay period it should have started
End DateStop costing as of a pay period end date.Last day of the last pay period it should apply
Delete RecordRemove a costing record completely.First day of the pay period of the record to remove

  • Don't End Date a prior period if you want to keep costing records that come after that date. End Date ends everything from that date forward.
  • After End Date, use Create (not Update) to add costing again later.
